notes.title: Compete in the Ultimate Puzzle Match in Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2, available today!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce [i]Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2[/i] is now available to purchase on Steam. This exciting action puzzle experience provides a variety of ways for players to showcase their skills, including a multitude of free content that has been added since the console launch last December. 

Steam users will be able to enjoy a slew of flashy features, including:
[list]
[*] An absolutely packed roster of [b]40 playable characters[/b], including the beloved Sonic the Hedgehog, each with their own unique stats and abilities you can carry with you to the robust, RPG-inspired [b]Skill Battle[/b] mode
[*] A variety of different modes supporting traditional and re-imagined ways to play the iconic puzzle games, such as Swap mode and Party mode
[*] An extensive [b]Adventure[/b] mode, featuring a brand-new story that brings together the game’s vibrant cast for endless exploration in overworld maps
[*] A bounty of competitive [b]Online [/b]features, as well as a co-op [b]Boss Raid[/b] mode where you must work together with three players to take down fierce CPU-controlled bosses, and a new [b]Spectator[/b] mode where you can cheer on others battling in Versus and Skill Battle matches
[*] [b]Color vision accessibility features[/b] which include adjustments for color saturation that can be toggled on or off throughout the game
[*] And much, [b]much[/b] more!
[/list]
[b]Limited-time Steam Launch Edition
[/b]
Steam players can also take advantage of the limited-time [b]Steam Launch Edition[/b]! Boost your strategy and give your team a power-up in [i]Puyo Puyo Tetris 2[/i]’s newly added Boss Raid mode or in Skill Battle mode with this pack of rare Item Cards--including three special cards featuring items from the Sonic the Hedgehog series!

[previewyoutube=30pjFGa9GA8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Puyo Puyo Tetris 2[/i] is now available to purchase for $29.99 on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1259790/Puyo_Puyo_Tetris_2/]Steam store page[/url]. For more information, be sure to visit the official website at https://puyo.sega.com/tetris2, and stay tuned to the official Puyo Puyo accounts on [url=https://twitter.com/puyoofficial]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PuyoOfficial]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/puyoofficial/]Instagram[/url] for all the latest.

notes.title: The 2.02 update for Puyo Puyo Champions is now live!
notes.content:
Full patch notes are as follows:
•	Spectate: The Spectate feature has been added to Online. Players can spectate Free Play matches created by other players.
•	Color Blind Settings: Color Blind Settings has been added to Options. Allows players to change the colors of Puyo skins.
•	New Characters: Rafisol and Paprisu have been added as hidden playable characters.
•	Game Speed: An option to change game speed has been added to the pre-match Game Settings. Allows the overall match speed to be slowed down. 
•	Puyo Skins: The Gummy skin has been added to Puyo Skins. 
•	Board Position: An option to choose what side your board appears on has been added to the pre-match settings. You can now select a Board to use during a match. 
•	Results: The Results screen has been updated to show more details after each match, such as maximum Chain unleashed. 
•	Semi-Auto: The Semi-Auto feature has been added. Allows autoplay during a match when Handicap settings are set to Sweet or Mild.

notes.title: Lessons and Challenge Mode Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Check out the latest update to Puyo Puyo Champions - Lessons Mode and Challenge Mode[/h1]

[u]Challenge Mode[/u]
Hone your Puyo skills by competing in various challenges including score-based and time-based scenarios where the goal is to get as many points as quickly possible. This mode also includes 3 new achievements!

[u]Lessons Mode[/u]
Check out Lessons Mode for tutorials featuring Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced lessons that take a deep dive into how to become better at Puyo Puyo, along with over 200 interactive problems to test your newfound skills.

[u]Patch Notes[/u]
Along with the new modes, this update also brings the following fixes and additions:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause low framerate issues when display is set to fullscreen and V-sync is enabled
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented a fourth controller from being used in 4-player local matches
[*]Disconnecting from a Puyo League match by adjusting the window size no longer results in a Rating increase
[*]Clicking outside of fullscreen window no longer causes it to minimize
[*]Gameplay automatically pauses when bringing up the Steam overlay
[*]Added a Delete All option for managing stored replays
[*]Added keyboard support for cheat commands
[*]Updated credits
[*]Various minor text and UI fixes
[/list]
